description: This file defines keyboard shortcut configurations and utility functions for handling keybindings in the Notesnook project, including categories, normalization, formatting, and platform-specific adjustments.

classes.name: Hotkeys
classes.description: Interface representing a hotkey configuration with keys, description, category, and type.

classes.name: TipTapKey
classes.description: Interface representing a TipTap editor keybinding with keys, description, category, and type.

methods.name: getKeybinding
methods.description: Retrieves the keybinding(s) for a given shortcut key, considering platform and Mac modifiers.

methods.name: normalizeKeys
methods.description: Normalizes key strings into an array based on platform (web or desktop).

methods.name: macify
methods.description: Replaces control and mod keys with Mac-specific symbols for display.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats a key string into a human-readable form, considering platform-specific symbols.

methods.name: getGroupedKeybindings
methods.description: Groups all keybindings by category, applying platform and Mac-specific modifications.
